The meatloaf has been sliced, revealing a dense, textured interior with visible flecks of ingredients (possibly corn or vegetables). The exterior is browned with a glossy, reddish-brown glaze on top. In the foreground, out of focus, are yellow side dishes (likely corn or potatoes) and a serving utensil (knife or spatula) resting in the pan.

The texture of the cut meat is very uniform. Some yellow/orange flecks inside look slightly like melted cheese or corn rather than traditional onion/breadcrumbs, but this is a valid culinary variation, not necessarily an artifact. However, the granularity is slightly 'mushy' rather than distinct fibers.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interior texture of the meatloaf. AI generators often struggle with the specific granular yet cohesive texture of cooked ground meat, sometimes making it look like smooth paste or overly distinct particles. Also, verify if the yellow flecks inside are physically plausible (e.g., corn, cheese, fat) or if they look like noise/artifacts. Check the boundary where the glaze meets the cut edge for any bleeding or unnatural blending.
